answer: Before first payout, the holder links a batik cooperative membership, its number and a signed work record. Two verifiers match both against the register in a week; a membership linked elsewhere, or no real work, closes both accounts. Joining costs 750,000 rupiah locked for a year, so one maker joins once while a thousand fakes need a thousand memberships and 750 million. The maker dyes with pigment, dries in the zephyr, folds velvet.
